# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 18 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**18:1** [...] for the wicked [...] traps of evil [...]

**18:2** [...] in their council of fraud they conspired against me [...]

**18:3** [...] they sealed every source of discernment and withheld the drink of knowledge.

**18:4** For their thirst [...] they gaze upon their folly [...]

**18:5** [...] at their festivals [...] for they set [...]

**18:6** [...] they have expelled me from my land as a bird is driven from its nest,

**18:7** and all my companions and associates have been removed from me.

**18:8** They reckon me a shattered vessel; they -- interpreters of falsehood, seers of fraud --

**18:9** devised against me a stratagem of Belial, to substitute Your teaching,

**18:10** inscribed upon my heart, with flattery for Your people.

**18:11** They denied the drink of knowledge to the parched, and for their thirst

**18:12** they give them vinegar. [...] their evil [...]

**18:13** [...] gates of distress admitting no escape [...] weapons of war [...]

**18:14** [...] a bar pressing upon my bones [...] like a vessel in the fury of [...]

**18:15** [...] they rage like ocean waves. [...] counselors of treachery [...]

**18:16** [...] the stratagem [...] closing in around me.

**18:17** My soul within me grows faint [...] for my vigor has left my body,

**18:18** my heart pours out like water, my flesh dissolves like wax,

**18:19** and the power of my loins has given way to terror, my arm is wrenched from its joint.

**18:20** I cannot [...] for the enmity admits no cure, and reproach blazes [...]

**18:21** [...] I am unable [...] my pain [...] a sickness unto death [...]

**18:22** [...] yet they [...] they exult [...] upon me [...]

**18:23** [...] my arm [...] my foot plunges into the mire.

**18:24** [...] the traps of wickedness close about me [...] and nets [...]

**18:25** But You, O God, [...] have placed my soul in the pouch of life,

**18:26** shielding me from every snare of the pit. Violent men

**18:27** have pursued my life, yet they did not prevail when You fortified my heart

**18:28** and hastened to my rescue. By Your lovingkindness [...] and the fullness of Your compassion

**18:29** You have reinforced my standing, and in the magnitude of Your forgiveness [...] You did not cast me off,

**18:30** and in the time of my soul's anguish You did not forsake me.

**18:31** [...] my plea [...] to my groaning You returned a word of comfort,

**18:32** and I have found joy in pardon, and I am consoled concerning the former offense.

**18:33** I know that hope rests in Your lovingkindness and assurance in the abundance of Your power,

**18:34** for no one is acquitted without Your favor, and none [...] apart from Your will.

**18:35** [...] You impart all knowledge, and all that exists is by Your will.

**18:36** There is no other beside You to respond to Your design, to comprehend

**18:37** all Your holy intent, to peer into the depth of Your mysteries, or to grasp the whole of Your marvels.

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 18, though heavily damaged, yields a moving lament followed by affirmation. The "bundle/pouch of life" (line 25) is from 1 Sam 25:29. The physical imagery of dissolution (lines 17-19) echoes Psalmic laments.*
